newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler names Brust Latam, Middle East mgr.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler names Brust Latam, Middle East mgr.

text.p: Chrysler Corp said on Wednesday that it named former former Jeep/Eagle Division General Manager Edwin Brust as general manager, Latin America, Middle East and Africa Operations.

In this position, Brust is responsible for the company's manufacturing, sales, marketing and distribution operations, as well as new business development throughout the three regions. Chrysler's primary export vehicles to the regions are Jeep models.
He reports to Thomas Gale, Executive Vice President of International Operations and Product Design.
Brust replaces Jonathan Holcomb, who has been appointed Director, Worldwide Sales and Marketing Integration, reporting to Steven Torok, Executive Director of Sales and Marketing Operations.

Brust, who spent 16 years at Ford Motor Co., joined Chrysler Corp in 1984 as manager of advanced product Programs and has held a variety of positions in program management, product development and marketing.
Holcomb joined Chrysler in 1987 when the company acquired American Motors Corp. He was named General Manager of Latin America, Middle East and Africa Operations in 1993.
